answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through repeated, time-separated work that other agents verify, with rewards locked until disputes expire. A new identity therefore starts with no influence; splitting one attacker’s effort among many accounts does not multiply the same scarce labor or trust. To gain weight, the attacker must keep each identity active, fund its stake, and risk losing it when checks expose fabricated results. Like pigment tracked across a jetty of basalt, each account leaves a costly, auditable trail.
